name: io.github.exquad/thecablecode
title: The Cable Code
description: Decode cables in 71 coding systems; design, rate, check, find equivalents; drums, laying, fire.

tools.name: decode_cable_code
tools.description: Decode a cable type designation (DIN VDE, HAR, BS/IEC, NEC, TS, UTE, CEI-UNEL and 64 more of its 71 coding systems, plus LAN and fibre) into its layers: conductor, insulation, screen, armour, sheath, with the source behind each symbol. Deterministic, no LLM. 5 free calls per caller per UTC day (with find_equivalents, overhead_conductor), then $0.10 USDC per call (x402).

code.description: A cable type designation as printed or listed.

lang.description: Any of the site's 15 languages; default en.

tools.name: design_cable
tools.description: Design and size a cable (power, control, LAN, coaxial, fibre) from a sentence in any site language, a designation, a spec or a design: each layer with its standard and source, diameter, weight, designation, current, voltage drop and short-circuit ratings, optional files (XML, DXF, SVG, CSV, GLB, STEP, PDF). Deterministic, no LLM; nominal values. Notes: thecablecode://guide/design_cable. 2 free designs per caller per UTC day, then $0.50 USDC per design (x402).

sentence.description: The cable in words (any site language) or a designation; what is not said takes a default, listed in the answer.
examples: 3-core collective screen 12/20 kV 3x95/25 Al, longitudinally watertight

spec.description: Or {voltage: "12/20", cores: 3, section: 95, metal, screen, insulation, sheath, armour, standard (a design_presets id), ...} or {lan: {category, shield, awg}}.

design.description: Instead of a sentence: the design field of an earlier answer, changed.

lang.description: Language of the answer's words; the sentence is read in any.

formats.description: Files to include: xml, dxf, svg, csv, glb, step, pdf (datasheet).

installation.description: For ratings.current: how the cable is installed; what is not given takes the defaults the answer lists.

laying.description: Buried, in a duct, or in air.

group.description: Cables or circuits side by side.

support.description: In air with a group: the support.

arrangement.description: 0.6/1 kV in air: how the group lies.

clearance.description: 0.6/1 kV: touching, oneDiameter, or a ground clearance, m.

circuit_use.description: 0.6/1 kV, Table 52.2: sets the smallest conductor.

loaded_cores.description: HD 603, over four cores: loaded cores.

is_pvc.description: rating_basis is3961, IS 1554-1: the PVC grade.

mv_install.description: Type MV and URD, NEC 315.60: the installation.

mv_temp_c.description: Type MV and URD: the 90 or 105 °C column.

reel_drum.description: A flexible cable on a reeling drum.

restrained.description: Short circuit: buried, clamped or bent tight.

lead_alloy.description: Short circuit: the lead sheath is a lead alloy.

strip_mm.description: Short circuit: armour strip thickness, mm.

load.description: For voltage_drop and sizing: {length_m (required), amps or kw, phases, volts, pf, limit_pct, conduit, formation}.

fault.description: For cpc: {ka, seconds}, the adiabatic check up to 1 kV.

cpc.description: The protective conductor check: {kind, system, device and device_a or ia_a, length_m, ...}.

nec.description: North American wires: {ocpd_a, install, ambient_c, carrying, termination_c}: NEC ampacity and EGC; CSA designs by C22.1.

test_variant.description: A national variant of the tests after installation; default the design standard's.

tools.name: find_equivalents
tools.description: The same power cable under other countries' standards (IEC 60502, HD 603, HD 620, BS, EN 50618, HD 627), rebuilt and compared layer by layer with sources: equivalent, close (the differences) or none (the reason). Deterministic, no LLM; never a statement of interchangeability. Notes: thecablecode://guide/find_equivalents. The decodes' 5 free calls per caller per UTC day, then $0.10 USDC per call (x402).

code.description: A power cable designation with its size and voltage.

design.description: Instead of code: a design (the design field of a design_cable answer), compared with its own layers.

country.description: Comma separated target countries: NL, SE, DK, NO, DE, GB, INT, EU, ES, IT, FR, PT, IN, CN, JP, AU, ZA, TH, US, CA. Default: all.

standard.description: Comma separated target standards, e.g. HD620-10J, BS6724, IEC, EN50618; default all. Every id: thecablecode://guide/find_equivalents.

lang.description: Language of the notes; default en.

tools.name: overhead_conductor
tools.description: A bare overhead line conductor (AAC, AAAC, ACSR, ACSS) by its code ("242-AL1/39-ST1A", EN 50182; "401-AL0/28-MEHST", FprEN 50540) or an EN 50182 Annex F table ("F.19"): stranding, areas, diameters, mass, strength and resistance as printed, with table and page. Deterministic, no LLM. Notes: thecablecode://guide/overhead_conductor. The decodes' 5 free calls per caller per UTC day, then $0.10 USDC per call (x402).

code.description: A bare overhead conductor code: EN 50182:2001 4.5, the envelope's area and wire then the core's, e.g. "242-AL1/39-ST1A", "65-A20SA", "434-AL1/56-ST1A"; or an ACSS code by FprEN 50540 clause 4, e.g. "401-AL0/28-MEHST", read by its areas. Every Annex F country table that lists it answers.

table.description: Instead of code (or to narrow it): an EN 50182 Annex F country table (52 tables). Alone it answers every row of the table.

row.description: With table: one conductor code of that table.

core.description: The core wire of the ACSS build (FprEN 50540 clause 4): ST6A, EHST, MEHST, UHST, MUHST, 20SA, 20EHSA, 14EHSA; default ST6A, or an ACSS code's own core.

tools.name: check_cable
tools.description: Check a power cable (a designation with size and voltage, a design, or a datasheet's construction) against a standard's nominal rules: each rule with required, found, pass / fail / not checkable and its source. Deterministic, no LLM; not a certificate or a type test. Notes: thecablecode://guide/check_cable. 2 free checks per caller per UTC day, then $0.50 USDC per check (x402).

designation.description: A power cable designation with its size and voltage.

design.description: Instead of a designation: a thecablecode design v1 (the design field of a design_cable answer).

construction.description: Or a datasheet's construction: {voltage: "12/20", cores, conductor: {metal, section}, core: [{kind, material, nominal, minimum}], common: [...], standards}, inside out.

tools.name: extract_datasheet
tools.description: Read a power cable datasheet (an https link to a PDF or page, or pasted text) into constructions: each size's voltage, cores, conductor, layers with nominal and smallest thickness, screen, armour, diameters and standards, with page and row. An LLM (Claude) reads, deciding nothing; with standard set the rules check each row. Notes: thecablecode://guide/extract_datasheet. Price (USDC, x402): a paid call from the first document: $2.00 in USDC per document, no free allowance.

url.description: An https link to a PDF datasheet or a datasheet web page.

text.description: Pasted datasheet, catalogue or tender text.

hint.description: A designation or size to look for, e.g. "3x95/25 12/20 kV": only matching rows are returned.

standard.description: Also check every row: "auto" (the standards each row claims, else IEC 60502 by voltage) or rule sets, comma separated.

tools.name: read_tender
tools.description: Read a tender or project document's text into its cables (built and checked by the rules), the required / offered schedule, requirements, conflicts and missing sections, with pages. An LLM (Claude) copies values, deciding nothing. Waits up to about two minutes, then answers a poll link (GET /api/v1/tender/{job}); a PDF: POST /api/v1/tender. Notes: thecablecode://guide/read_tender. Always paid: $4.00 up to 20 pages, $2.00 for each further 10 pages begun, up to 80 pages, USDC (x402).

text.description: The document's text (a Word file turned into text); it counts one page per 1,700 characters begun.

hint.description: A cable tag or a voltage to look for first.

lang.description: The language of the schedule's parameter names: any of the site's 15 (en, tr, de, nl, sv, fr, es, da, no, fi, it, ro, pl, cs, ru). Default en.

tools.name: write_specification
tools.description: Write the cable specification for a tender, one cable or a project, each as design_cable takes it, with the project's requirements: the specification in tender order (Markdown and text) and the required / offered schedule (CSV and JSON), REQUIRED filled with sources, OFFERED left for the bidder. Deterministic, no LLM; a draft to check. Notes: thecablecode://guide/write_specification. Always paid: $2.00 for the first cable, $0.50 for each further cable in the same call, up to 30, USDC (x402).

sentence.description: One cable, as design_cable takes it.

installation.description: For the current rating row, as design_cable takes it.

fault_s.description: Fault duration for the short-circuit rows, s (default 1).

drum.description: The drums section's line; absent: the bidder proposes.

cables.description: Or a project: cables, each {sentence | spec | design, installation, fault_s, drum}.

requirements.description: Requirement ids (rodent, uv-sunlight, flame-bunched, fire-resistance, longitudinal-watertight ...), or {id, option}; set on every cable. Every id and option: thecablecode://guide/write_specification or GET /api/v1/spec/requirements.

lang.description: Language of the specification; default en.

tools.name: design_presets
tools.description: What design_cable builds: presets[] (power, MV, HV, North American, building wire, cords, control, LAN, coaxial, fibre), each with the sentence that builds it, its designation, voltage, cores, section and metal; and spec_standards[], the families a spec may name in spec.standard. Takes only lang. Free, no LLM.

lang.description: Language of the preset sentences and names; default en.

tools.name: drum_fit
tools.description: Which cable drum (reel) a length needs (od, length), or what one drum takes (od, D, d, W): nested whole layers on 1.05 x OD under a freeboard, over KTG, Nordic K, DIN, Spanish, NEMA, Turkish, IS 10418 and makers' drums with sources, with barrel and load checks; reeling adds the NFPA 79 derating, lagging the handling block. Notes: thecablecode://guide/drum_fit. Free, outside the daily calls; deterministic, no LLM.

od.description: Cable outer diameter, mm (a flat cable: its larger side).

kg.description: Cable mass, kg/km: adds weights and the load check.

kind.description: Cable kind for the smallest barrel; default lv-multi.

max.description: Most drums of one size the length may be split over; default 1.

freeboard.description: Freeboard to the flange rim, mm.

D.description: A drum by its dimensions: flange diameter, mm.

d.description: Barrel diameter, mm, less than D.

W.description: Winding width between the flanges, mm.

barrel_od.description: A bundle's lay-up diameter for the barrel check, mm; default od.

free_height.description: With D, d and W, a part-used drum: flange rim down to the cable top, mm.

pool.description: With length, 1: pooled sizes over makers (pools[]) instead of one row per drum.

reeling.description: A motor-driven reeling drum: adds the NFPA 79 (2024) derating.

layers.description: With reeling: the layers wound; default 1.

lagging.description: Adds the handling and storage block, with this lagging.

handling.description: 1: the handling block with lagging none.

material.description: With D, d and W: the drum's material for the handling block (default wood).

lang.description: The handling block's words: any of the site's 15 languages.

tools.name: burial_depth
tools.description: Minimum burial cover of a power cable by country, voltage and place (open ground, road, pavement; direct or in a raceway for US and AU), from that country's rule with its source and seen level, or null with the reason. Free, no LLM. Notes: thecablecode://guide/burial_depth.

u.description: U in kV (1 for 0.6/1 kV, 20 for 12/20 kV) or Uo/U such as "0.6/1".

place.description: field (open ground, default), road or pavement.

method.description: direct (default) or raceway (duct or conduit); the US and Australian rules tell them apart.

tools.name: fire_class
tools.description: The lowest fire class or listing a country asks for in a kind of building or space (DE, ES, FR, GB, IT, TR, US: escape route, high-rise, tunnel, hospital, plenum ...), the rule lines with sources and seen levels; the US NEC Article 722 listing ladders. To read a printed class use decode_cable_code. Free, no LLM. Notes: thecablecode://guide/fire_class.

country.description: ISO country code of the installation.

place.description: The kind of building or space: escape (escape route), general, highrise, tunnel, hospital, datacentre, plenum, riser or railway.

tools.name: awg_metric
tools.description: AWG / kcmil against IEC 60228 mm2, both ways, by area and by maximum resistance at 20 °C, each size with its resistance and source; with k, the ICEA insulation constant in MΩ·km. Send awg or mm2, metal Cu (default) or Al. Free, no LLM. Notes: thecablecode://guide/awg_metric.

k.description: An ICEA insulation constant K, MΩ·1000 ft at 15.6 °C.

tools.name: conduit_fill
tools.description: NEC Chapter 9 conduit fill: the smallest trade size of a raceway type (EMT, IMC, RMC, PVC, ENT, FMC, LFNC, LFMC, HDPE ...) for a list of conductors or cables, against Table 1's fill limits, with the jam ratio; each area with its table. Free, no LLM. Notes: thecablecode://guide/conduit_fill.

type.description: Conductor type, or "od" for a cable by its diameter.

count.description: How many of this row, 1 to 200.

od_mm.description: With type "od": the cable's diameter, mm.

cables.description: Conductor rows: {type (THHN, XHHW, THW, RHW, RHW*, USE-2, THHN-5A ... bare, bare-solid), size (AWG or kcmil), count}, or a cable by its diameter {type: "od", od_mm, count}.

tools.name: pull_cable
tools.description: Pull a cable through straights and bends (conduit or rollers): tension per segment from either end, sidewall pressure per bend, jam ratio and fill, against the allowable values with sources. $0.50 USDC per calculation (x402); the verdict alone (no full) is free within the designs' 2 calls per caller per UTC day. Notes: thecablecode://guide/pull_cable.

sentence.description: The cable, as design_cable takes it.

input.description: input: {route: [{kind: "straight", length, slope} | {kind: "bend", radius, angle, plane}], n, duct: {kind: "conduit", material, idMm} | {kind: "rollers"}, head, ...}

items.description: Or a list of {sentence | spec | design, input}, paid per item.

pdf.description: Full mode: add the calculation sheet as pdf_base64.

tools.name: tray_fill
tools.description: NEC cable tray fill (392.22) and each cable's derated ampacity (392.80), up to 2000 V and Type MV: pass or fail. A conduit: conduit_fill (free). $0.50 USDC per calculation (x402); the verdict alone (no full) is free within the designs' 2 calls per caller per UTC day. Notes: thecablecode://guide/tray_fill.

input.description: input: {tray, width (mm), use, layout, ambientC, mv, cables: [{kind, size, metal, count, od, tempC, carrying}], ...}

items.description: Or a list of {input}, paid per item.

pdf.description: Full mode: add the calculation sheet as pdf_base64.

tools.name: drum_loading
tools.description: How filled drums travel: vehicles needed by space and payload, rows, chocks, and EN 12195-1 securing (blocking, lashings), each vehicle compared, with sources. Choose the drum with drum_fit (free). $0.50 USDC per calculation (x402); the verdict alone (no full) is free within the designs' 2 calls per caller per UTC day. Notes: thecablecode://guide/drum_loading.

input.description: input: {vehicle, dt (transport diameter, mm), width (mm), gross (kg per drum), qty, ...}

items.description: Or a list of {input}, paid per item.

tools.name: cold_weather_check
tools.description: A place's long-term mean daily minimum in a month (NASA POWER, stored) against the design's minimum laying temperature: comfortable, marginal, prewarm or unknown. $0.50 USDC per calculation (x402), no free allowance. Notes: thecablecode://guide/cold_weather_check.

sentence.description: The cable, as design_cable takes it.

items.description: Or a list of {sentence | spec | design, input}, paid per item.

Notes: thecablecode://guide/iec60287_rating.

tools.description: Days an XLPE MV or HV core needs in the oven before its sheath (Fick diffusion, published coefficients): a band, not a standard's result; the AEIC CS8-20 wait beside it up to 46 kV. $5.00 USDC per calculation (x402), no free allowance. Notes: thecablecode://guide/degassing_time.
